guide.title: Usage Guide
guide.intro: English Read keeps reading and vocabulary in one workflow. Follow these steps to get started.
guide.beginnerBody: Start with lower-vocabulary graded books in the public library—preferably the Elementary 2K tier (about 1,000–2,000 core words). Tap the "Elementary 2K" filter at the top of the public library. Move up to 3K, 4K, and beyond once you feel comfortable.
guide.step1Body: Browse the public library or upload your own EPUB under My Bookshelf. Tap Start Reading on a book detail page to add it to your shelf automatically.
guide.step2Body: Read page by page in the reader. Select a word or phrase to see phonetics, English definitions, and Chinese translation, then save it to your vocabulary list with the original context.
guide.step3Body: The dashboard and vocabulary page show how many words are due. Review includes meaning choice and spelling practice, scheduled by Ebbinghaus intervals (1 → 2 → 4 → 7 → 15 → 30 days). See the Review Plan calendar for upcoming sessions.
guide.step4Body: Open Study Statistics for reading time, reading speed, words reviewed, and error rate. The dashboard also shows a 14-day overview chart.
